title: billing.hold
description: Payload for the billing.hold comm Function — reserve credits before doing work whose real cost is not known yet (wrapper over stapel_billing.services.hold). The credits leave the wallet's lots immediately, expiring-soonest first; no ledger row is written until the hold is captured. idempotency_key is REQUIRED and unique per wallet: comm delivery is at-least-once and a retry with the same key returns the original hold instead of reserving twice. expires_in_seconds overrides STAPEL_BILLING['HOLD_DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS'] — the deadline after which expire_holds gives the credits back, so a pipeline that dies mid-charge cannot lock them forever. Returns {"ok": bool, "hold_id": str|null, "balance": int|null, "reason": str|null}; reason is one of user_not_found, insufficient_credits, hold_already_resolved. hold_already_resolved means the key belongs to a hold that is already captured, released or expired (the answer also carries that hold's id and status): nothing is reserved under it, so it is a refusal — a NEW operation needs a new key, while a genuine retry of a finished one has nothing left to do.
